extracted.intended_audience: students, scholars, and readers of Renaissance literature (readers of Castiglione's The Courtier)
extracted.subtask_description: Explanatory and bibliographic notes for the dedicatory letter and first book of Baldassare Castiglione's The Courtier, aimed at clarifying historical persons, dates, editions, and textual references. Provides background biographical sketches and cross-references for readers of the edition.
